sloka: ब्राह्मणो वा ऽसि भद्रं ते क्षत्रियो वा ऽसि दुर्जयः ।वैश्यस्तृतीयवर्णो वा शूद्रो वा सत्यवाग्भव ।। ७.७५.१८ ।।
transliteration: brāhmaṇo vā 'si bhadraṁ te kṣatriyo vā 'si durjayaḥ ।vaiśyastṛtīyavarṇo vā śūdro vā satyavāgbhava ।। 7.75.18 ।।

translations.english: Rama asks the ascetic to truthfully state his varna, whether he is a Brahmana, a Kshatriya, a Vaishya, or a Shudra, wishing him well regardless.
